description: Per-residue buried surface area of the human BAG1 ubiquitin-like domain at the Rpn1 interface in 9HEU, with worm equivalents
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0"})
cif=open("9HEU.cif").read() if __import__("os").path.exists("9HEU.cif") else S.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/9HEU.cif",timeout=300).text
lines=cif.split("\n"); i=0
while not lines[i].startswith("_atom_site."): i+=1
hdr=[]
while lines[i].startswith("_atom_site."): hdr.append(lines[i].strip().split(".")[1]); i+=1
rows=[]
while not lines[i].startswith("#"):
    p=lines[i].split()
    if len(p)==len(hdr): rows.append(p)
    i+=1
c={h:k for k,h in enumerate(hdr)}
ch=np.array([r[c["auth_asym_id"]] for r in rows]); resi=np.array([int(r[c["auth_seq_id"]]) for r in rows])
resn=np.array([r[c["auth_comp_id"]] for r in rows])
el=np.array([r[c["type_symbol"]] for r in rows])
xyz=np.array([[float(r[c["Cartn_x"]]),float(r[c["Cartn_y"]]),float(r[c["Cartn_z"]])] for r in rows])
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
     'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
RAD={'C':1.70,'N':1.55,'O':1.52,'S':1.80,'P':1.80,'SE':1.90}
PROBE=1.4; N=300
gi=np.arange(N)+0.5; phi=np.arccos(1-2*gi/N); th=np.pi*(1+5**0.5)*gi
SPH=np.c_[np.cos(th)*np.sin(phi),np.sin(th)*np.sin(phi),np.cos(phi)]
def sasa(X,R):
    out=np.zeros(len(X))
    for k in range(len(X)):
        rk=R[k]+PROBE; pts=X[k]+rk*SPH
        d=np.linalg.norm(X[:,None]-pts[None],axis=2)
        lim=(R+PROBE)[:,None]; lim[k]=-1
        out[k]=4*np.pi*rk*rk*np.mean(~(d<lim).any(0))
    return out
sel_b=(ch=="x")&np.isin(el,list(RAD)); sel_f=(ch=="f")&np.isin(el,list(RAD))
Xb,Rb=xyz[sel_b],np.array([RAD[e] for e in el[sel_b]])
Xf,Rf=xyz[sel_f],np.array([RAD[e] for e in el[sel_f]])
# restrict Rpn1 to atoms within 15 A of BAG1 to keep the calculation tractable
near=np.min(np.linalg.norm(Xf[:,None]-Xb[None],axis=2),axis=1)<15
Xf,Rf=Xf[near],Rf[near]
free=sasa(Xb,Rb)
comp=sasa(np.vstack([Xb,Xf]),np.concatenate([Rb,Rf]))[:len(Xb)]
bur=free-comp
ri=resi[sel_b]+115; rn=np.array([AA3.get(a,'X') for a in resn[sel_b]])
tb=pd.DataFrame({"res":ri,"aa":rn,"bur":bur}).groupby(["res","aa"],as_index=False)["bur"].sum()
tb=tb[tb.bur>1].sort_values("bur",ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
tb["BAG1S"]=tb.res-115
tot=tb.bur.sum()
PATCH={151:"Leu8-eq",189:"Arg42-eq",191:"Ile44-eq",192:"Phe45-eq",195:"Lys48-eq",196:"Gln49-eq",216:"His68-eq",218:"Val70-eq",219:"Leu71-eq",220:"Arg72-eq"}
tb["ubq_equiv"]=tb.res.map(PATCH).fillna("")
WORM={151:"S8",187:"T47",189:"K49",190:"L50",191:"L51",192:"H52",193:"R53",194:"G54",195:"K55",196:"F56",197:"L57",198:"Q58",214:"K75",216:"I77",218:"M79",219:"G80",220:"G81",221:"K82",223:"A84"}
tb["worm"]=tb.res.map(WORM).fillna("-")
print(f"BAG1 ULD surface buried by Rpn1 in 9HEU: {tot:.0f} A^2 (half of the 748 A^2 total interface)")
print(tb.to_string(index=False,float_format=lambda v:f"{v:.1f}"))
patch_area=tb[tb.ubq_equiv!=""].bur.sum()
print(f"\nfraction of buried BAG1 area contributed by Ile44-patch-equivalent positions: {patch_area/tot:.2f}")
k220=float(tb.loc[tb.res==220,"bur"].sum()) if (tb.res==220).any() else 0.0
print(f"Arg72-equivalent Lys220 buries {k220:.1f} A^2 ({k220/tot*100:.1f}% of the BAG1 side); this is the one position worm BAG-1 loses (Gly81)")
tb.to_csv("9HEU_BAG1_buried_area.csv",index=False)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11,4.2))
cols=["#4C78A8" if w=="-" else ("#E45756" if r==220 else "#54A24B") for r,w in zip(tb.res,tb.worm)]
ax.bar(range(len(tb)),tb.bur,color=cols)
ax.set_xticks(range(len(tb)))
ax.set_xticklabels([f"{a}{r}\n{w}" for a,r,w in zip(tb.aa,tb.res,tb.worm)],fontsize=7)
ax.set_ylabel(r"buried surface area ($\AA^2$)")
ax.set_xlabel("human BAG1 residue (Q99933 numbering), worm BAG-1 equivalent below")
ax.set_title("Human BAG1 ubiquitin-like domain surface buried by Rpn1 in cryo-EM 9HEU, Shrake-Rupley\n"
             "green, worm equivalent conserved in character; red, Lys220 lost in the worm (Gly81); blue, no worm contact mapped")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
